{{Quote|Records drawn from Yaga Minor Ubiqtorate Base, Carida, and Corellia|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
The '''Yaga Minor Ubiqtorate Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] base for the [[Ubiqtorate]]<ref name="Rise" />—the leadership branch of [[Imperial Intelligence]]<ref name="DoR">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref>—located at<ref name="Rise" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Galaxy Map">{{GalaxyMapPoster}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Yaga Minor system]]</ref> [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Yaga Minor]].<ref name="Rise" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="RiseDate">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] referenced records drawn from the base, as well as from<ref name="Rise" /> the planets<ref name="Battles" /> [[Corellia]] and [[Carida]], when<ref name="Rise" /> he<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> discussed the difficulty of determining the exact number of [[Star Destroyer]]s manufactured by the company [[Kuat Drive Yards]] in his [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yaga Minor Ubiqtorate Base was mentioned in the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'', by Dr. [[Chris Kempshall]].<ref name="Rise" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, an [[Ubiqtorate base]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] first appeared in the [[1997]] novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', the first book of [[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology|The Hand of Thrawn Duology]] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
